name: Animate Trees
description:
Concentration, up to 1 day.

Once per day: Choose one or two living trees within medium range. Each tree becomes a plant creature with a BODY score of 6, 1 rank in Awe, 3 ranks in Strength 2 ranks in Fortitude, a Speed of 30, a base Defense of 13, a Reach of 5ft, and its unarmed melee attacks deal 1d20+BODY damage.

You may spend a half action to turn one or both of the trees back into an inanimate tree. If you fall unconscious while maintaining concentration, the trees die.
